messages:
alina: Quick design callout — users keep hitting the inline 'Promote' / 'Rollback' buttons on the timeline by accident on small screens. We should rethink discovery and wording.

jon: Idea: make the inline primary action non-destructive: 'Open promote preview' (or 'Open revert preview'). Move destructive actions to overflow -> 'Promote (force)' / 'Revert (force)'.

miriam: A11y: accessible name must include scope & consequence. Ex: aria-label="Open promote preview for version v3.2.1, shows traffic and metric deltas". Confirmation dialogs need focus trap + commit sha readout.

sam: For keyboard users surface a local help hint in the popover: 'r = preview revert, p = preview promote'. Make shortcuts opt-in (power shortcuts toggle) to avoid surprises.

rachel: Visual problem: stacked canary bars lose meaning when compressed. Propose patterned fills + thin outlines per variant for HC mode. Also add a small toggle to switch legend into an icon-only compact mode.

jon: CSS sample for patterns (small): ` .v-a{background-image:repeating-linear-gradient(45deg,rgba(0,0,0,0.04)0 5px,transparent 5px 10px);} .v-b{background-image:repeating-linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(0,0,0,0.05)0 5px,transparent 5px 10px);} `

miriam: Ensure focus outline sits above pattern. Use outline: 3px solid var(--hc-outline); outline-offset:2px. Announce scrubber focus with aria-live="polite".

alina: Toast copy tweak: change 'Rollback started' to 'Revert started — view progress or undo (30s)'. Also keep an 'Undo' affordance in the timeline entry for the 30s window.

sam: Also add a tiny 'why' link inside the confirmation that expands to show who deployed, commit message, and expected metric impact. Helpful for PMs.

rachel: For extra-destructive 'Force' actions require typed confirmation of the version id or sha. Makes accidental clicks harder.

devops-bot: queued-tests: please add keyboard-e2e + a11y-smoke to PR. job#6102. :white_check_mark:

miriam: Quick checklist: 1) non-destructive inline primary, 2) destructive actions in overflow with typed confirm, 3) aria-labels with intent+scope, 4) polite aria-live for scrubber, 5) patterned fills + visible focus outline, 6) undo toast + timeline affordance.

alina: Great, I'll update the figma with the 'preview' primary, overflow 'force' with typed confirm, small legend toggle, and notes for a11y review. Tagging @jon and @miriam for handoff.
